# best-effort-side-channels

**Claim.** A channel that reports on an operation must never be able to fail it.

**Not when.** When the side channel is the product · When the channel is the only record · When swallowing hides a systemic failure

**Check.** make the side call raise in a test: the operation succeeds and the failure leaves a distinct log line

*reasoned.* Open the full note only when you cannot tell whether its boundary holds here: [best-effort-side-channels](../notes/active/best-effort-side-channels.md).
